title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
content: Blockchain investigation traced $518 million in illicit-linked activity, including the 2025 Bybit hack, through a key reserve backing DAI and USDS tokens, putting Sky's institutional finance ambitions and open design on collision course.

title: Anthropic’s $107 billion sale set to top SpaceX’s IPO as tokenized stocks gain traction
content: The maker of Claude priced its Nasdaq debut at $83 a share for a $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation, with the Nasdaq 100 down 14% from record highs.

title: ‘Highly advanced’ quantum computers could crack financial encryption in five years
content: No quantum computer can yet break widely used cryptography, but the securities watchdog says banks and blockchains face a yearslong security overhaul that many have barely begun.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin nears $64,000 as Anthropic’s record IPO lifts tech
content: Nasdaq futures jumped nearly 2% with Anthropic shares indicated as much as 24% higher, and one analyst said IPO money could flow back into crypto.

title: Singapore settles $77.5 million tokenized bill sale in local CBDC
content: The central bank aims to expand this digital settlement network and test wider collateral use in 2027.

title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
content: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
content: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
content: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.

title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
content: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
content: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

title: GameStop CEO Says Digital-Only Games Have ‘Hurt Consumers’ as GTA 6 Skips Discs
content: Ryan Cohen said publishers are cutting out trade-ins, as he backs a U.S. bill that would guarantee gamers keep access to games they buy.

title: Bitcoin Struggles to Hold $64,000 as ETF Outflows Hit $2.9B in November
content: Bitcoin is down 13% in a week as investors pull money from spot ETFs and brace for another Federal Reserve rate hike.

title: Ledger Confirms Tampered Bitcoin Wallets in Berlin as Spy Implant Probe Spreads Beyond Asia
content: Ledger says its hardware implant investigation has confirmed tampered devices in Berlin and is examining two suspected units in Dubai, as the incident spreads beyond Southeast Asia.

title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
content: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

title: Palmer Luckey Says He’s Building an Offshore Haven for Industry—And 'Illegal' Medicine
content: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.
